summary: Carve out bone structure. A cool-toned, emollient cream designed to mimic the exact shade of natural shadows on the face.
description: Precision structural shaping. Unlike warm bronzers, this dense cream utilizes cool, grey-leaning undertones to create the optical illusion of recessed features, allowing for profound facial architecture and restructuring.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 8g, this KoColor CONTOUR is expertly formulated with Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, and Iron Oxides. It delivers a high-fidelity Cool Shadow color profile (`#8B5A2B`) and leverages shadow-mimicry pigment theory.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply precisely to the hollows of the cheeks, jawline, and sides of the nose.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Always blend upwards. Blending contour downwards drags the architectural lines of the face, aging the profile.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: High dimethicone content ensures the cream glides over foundation without disrupting the base layer.
